image_description: A close-up, cropped view of a grey whale's back and dorsal area surfacing in blue water. The image highlights the mottled grey skin texture with white barnacle patches and the characteristic dorsal knuckles (humps) instead of a dorsal fin. Water splashes are visible around the body.

The background water has a uniform, painterly blur that lacks natural wave variation, though this could also be attributed to depth-of-field effects. It is barely noticeable but worth noting as a potential generative smoothing artifact.
